traditionalDress.men: Dhoti or kurta with a colourful safa or pagri turban; dress varies by community and region.
traditionalDress.women: Ghagra-choli with odhni is widely associated with traditional Rajasthani dress, alongside regional saree styles.

festivals.name: Gangaur
festivals.description: A widely observed festival honouring Gauri and associated with women, marriage, seasonal rituals and colourful processions.

festivals.name: Teej
festivals.description: A monsoon festival particularly associated with women, swings, songs, dress and devotional observances.

festivals.name: Pushkar Fair
festivals.description: A major annual fair known for livestock trading, pilgrimage, craft markets and cultural performances.

folklore: Rajasthan's folklore preserves ballads of local heroes, devotional figures and legendary romances. Oral singers, puppeteers and travelling performers have carried these stories across generations.
